title: Squire v0.1 build sequence
buildPhilosophy: Eight rounds, built one at a time and in order, each a build spec here: Round 1, then Round 1b (the Rule of Two's marks, inserted after Round 1), then Round 2 to Round 7. Every round runs DEFINE, BUILD, REVIEW, TEST and FINALISE. A criterion is scheduled in more than one round when a later round builds another surface of the same promise.
